map_intro.vote.can_select.true: Will appear in the vote pool

map_intro.property.bell_meeting_enabled: Map allows you to start a meeting by ringing a bell
map_intro.property.can_swim.true: Swimming is allowed on this map
map_intro.property.can_swim.false: Swimming is not allowed on this map
map_intro.property.oxygen_drowning: Players drown when they run out of oxygen
map_intro.property.can_jump.true: Jumping is allowed on this map
map_intro.property.can_jump.false: Jumping is not allowed on this map
map_intro.property.sand: Dust storms occur on this map
map_intro.property.plane_crash: This map has a plane-crash event: at the start a plane crashes into the center, buildings shake intermittently, and indoor areas may catch fire
map_intro.block.noellesroles.poison_zone: Poison zones poison any player who enters them, ideal for creating hazardous areas or trap zones.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.breaking_br: Breaking bridge blocks act as floor mechanisms that snap or collapse, creating movement hazards. They regenerate after a while.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.sabotage_br: Can be triggered by a sabotage task, activating the bridge mechanism once the sabotage starts.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.dripping_st: At random intervals a dripping stalactite falls downward, killing any player standing beneath it.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.fog_zone.de: Fog zones create localized fog that blocks vision. Staying in the fog too long kills you from losing your way, and you cannot activate your see-through instinct inside. Only Killers, Neutrals, and certain roles may enter.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.manhole.des: Manholes serve as map passages, hidden entrances, or fast-travel points. Staying inside too long kills you by suffocation. Only Killers, Neutrals, and certain roles may enter.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.cellar.desc: Right-click to open; the cellar door closes automatically and cannot be reopened for a while.
Can be triggered by a sabotage task. It stays open normally and closes when a sabotage task is triggered.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.flamethrowe: Can be triggered by a sabotage task. Used as a map mechanism, it creates a flaming hazard zone that burns players to death. Can be triggered by redstone.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.rolling_sto: Can be triggered by a sabotage task. The rolling-stone pressure plate summons a rolling boulder when stepped on.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.train_targe: The train target emits a redstone signal when shot with a firearm.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.incinerator: A small ignition zone lies in front of the incinerator; pushing a player into it kills them.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.moving_plat: Moving blocks create a moving platform.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.hurricane_d: The hurricane device creates wind fields or storm mechanisms that lift players up and throw them away.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.coffin.desc: When a player stays near a coffin too long, a husk is summoned. It automatically seeks nearby Adventure-mode players, and any player touched by the husk dies.
Right-click the water pump 5 times to receive a glass of water.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.trash_can.d: Right-click the trash can while holding an item to directly clear the held item per its config. Creative players right-click empty-handed to configure the destroy whitelist and blacklist.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.vending_mac: Vending machines can be configured with products; players interact with them to buy supplies on the map.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.lottery_mac: Lottery machines can be configured with a prize pool and weights, used to obtain random rewards on the map.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.devil_roule: The devil roulette table is a special mechanic of the roulette mode; players gather around it to trigger the roulette game.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.repair_hotb: Searchable barrel cabinets are used for looting gameplay; players can open them and take the items inside.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.supply_crat: Supply crates provide map supplies; they can be configured to periodically generate specific items.
Any player who touches a kill block dies instantly. It may contain water.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.kill_block_: Any player who touches a kill block panel dies instantly. It may contain water.
map_intro.block.starrailexpress.train_li: Train lights are invisible or low-profile scene lights that can be affected by redstone and the train light-off mechanism.
map_intro.block.starrailexpress.remote_r: Wireless redstone transmits a redstone signal from one place to a bound target, enabling cross-area mechanism linkage.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.trimm: Trimmed lanterns are controllable scene light sources, ideal for map lighting.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.wall_: Wall lamps are wall-mounted scene light sources, ideal for lighting corridors and rooms.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.neon_: Neon pillars are decorative scene blocks that also provide lighting.
Neon tubes are slender scene light sources that can be used for lighting.
map_intro.block.starrailexpress.entity_i: Entity interaction blocks are versatile blocks with configurable trigger conditions and contents, used to build complex map mechanisms, commands, teleports, rewards, or status changes.
Entity interaction panels work the same as entity interaction blocks.
map_intro.block.starrailexpress.ticket_o: Ticket offices handle ticket-related scene interactions; players can buy tickets here (some tickets have a limited number of uses).
map_intro.block.starrailexpress.ticket_g: Ticket gates are controlled by tickets. Holding the matching ticket opens the gate, and a redstone signal can force it open. They can serve as entrances to special areas, access controls, or mechanism doors. (In Creative, right-click the gate while holding a ticket to bind it.)
map_intro.block.starrailexpress.effect_g: Potion effect generators can be configured to grant a specified potion effect to players within an area, used for area buffs, penalties, or special mechanics.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.reactor.des: The reactor is one of the task points for resolving a sabotage task; there may be 1-2 on the map.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.water_valve: The water valve is one of the task points for resolving a sabotage task; there may be 1-2 on the map.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.debris_pile: Debris piles are usually one of the task points for resolving a sabotage task; there may be more than 2 on the map.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.scene_stove: The stove is a warming scene task point. Right-click to light it, then stay nearby for a while to complete the warming task; it also instantly refills your warmth.
Dust is a sweep-the-floor scene task point. Hold a vanilla brush and right-click the dust to sweep it.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.transport_p: Transport points are used for the deliver-supplies scene task. The green frame is the start, and the red frame is the destination.
map_intro.block.noellesroles.scene_statu: The statue is a pray scene task point. You must look at the statue from within six blocks.
The bush is a trim-bushes scene task point. Hold shears and right-click the bush to trim it.
The straw mat is a stretch-your-legs scene task point. You must jump around on the mat.
map_intro.block.minecraft.black_concrete: Run on the black concrete to complete the exercise task.
map_intro.block.minecraft.note_block.des: The note block is one of the regular task points, used for the play-music task.
map_intro.block.minecraft.lectern.desc: A lectern with a book is one of the regular task points, used for the reading task.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.light: The light toilet is one of the regular task points, used for the use-the-toilet task.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.dark_: The dark toilet is one of the regular task points, used for the use-the-toilet task.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.white: The white trimmed bed is one of the regular task points, used for the sleep task.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.red_t: The red trimmed bed is one of the regular task points, used for the sleep task.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.stain: The stainless steel shower head serves as a bathing task point, used for the shower task area on the map.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.gold_: The gold shower head serves as a bathing task point, used for the shower task area.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.food_: The food platter is one of the regular task points; players complete the eating task here.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.drink: The drink tray is one of the regular task points; players complete the drinking task here.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.camer: Cameras are placed for security and surveillance; combined with map mechanics they can create observation points.
map_intro.block.trainmurdermystery.secur: Security monitors are used to view the camera feeds.
map_intro.block.starrailexpress.minigame: Minigame task point blocks are used to configure minigame tasks, sabotage tasks, or specific role task points.
Minigame task point panels are thin, panel-shaped minigame task points, ideal for wall-mounted or hidden placement.
map_intro.mechanic.tasks.title: Regular and Scene Tasks
map_intro.mechanic.tasks.body:
Regular tasks appear on every map; scene tasks only appear on specific maps.
Regular tasks include: sleep, read, eat, drink, exercise, meditate, shower, play music, use the toilet, rest on a chair, and be alone for a while
Scene tasks include: breathe fresh air, warm up, sweep dust, deliver supplies, pray, trim bushes, and stretch your legs
Breathe fresh air: stand somewhere where you can see the sky
Warm up: right-click to light the stove block and stay beside it for a while
Sweep dust: hold a vanilla brush and right-click the dust to sweep it
Deliver supplies: pick up supplies at the transport point start (green frame) and bring them to the transport point destination (red frame)
Pray: look at the statue block from within six blocks
Trim bushes: hold shears and right-click the bush block
Stretch your legs: jump around on the straw mat
map_intro.mechanic.status_bar.title: Special Status Bars
map_intro.mechanic.status_bar.body:
Warmth: when you are somewhere you can see the sky, warmth drops by 1 point every 20 seconds (stacks). When standing on ice / blue ice / packed ice / snow / snow blocks, it drops by 1 point every 15 seconds (stacks). In powder snow, warmth drops by 1 point every 2 seconds. Getting hit by a snowball immediately reduces warmth by 2 points. Wearing any piece of leather armor slows the warmth loss; wearing 3 or more pieces of leather armor stops it from dropping. Indoors (where you cannot see the sky), warmth recovers by 1 point every 10 seconds. Standing beside the mod's stove task point instantly refills warmth to full. When warmth hits zero, you freeze to death.
Thirst: when you are somewhere you can see the sky, thirst drops by 1 point every 25 seconds (stacks). When sprinting, thirst drops by 1 point every 30 seconds of running (stacks). Drinking a beverage item from the mod restores 4 thirst points; drinking "a glass of water" restores 10. Being immersed in water restores 1 thirst point every 20 seconds. When thirst hits zero, you die of thirst.
Hunger: every 1.5 minutes of game time, hunger drops by 2 points. When sprinting, hunger drops by 2 points every 20 seconds of running (stacks). Eating food restores hunger. When hunger hits zero, you starve to death.
Pollution: pollution starts at 0 and maxes at 20; Killer team roles do not have it. It rises by 1 point every 15 seconds while soaking in water (stacks) and by 1 point every 8 seconds in the rain (stacks). Standing under a shower head lowers it by 1 point every 2.5 seconds. When pollution is maxed, mood drops by 0.05 points per second (down to 0), and you receive Slowness I and Blindness II.
map_intro.mechanic.sabotage.title: Sabotage Tasks
map_intro.mechanic.sabotage.body:
When a map has minigame tasks enabled, it may contain sabotage tasks for the Killer or certain roles. Sabotage task points can be spotted via the see-through instinct by the Killer or certain roles. The Killer or certain roles can start a sabotage at a sabotage task point (by completing a minigame).
When a sabotage starts, an alarm sounds across the map, and the mechanisms tied to it trigger directly. Players must go to the corresponding "sabotage-resolution task points" to actively resolve the sabotage. These resolution points are usually: reactor core, water valve, and debris piles. There are 1-2 reactor cores/water valves, and possibly more than 2 debris piles. The sabotage is only resolved once all reactor cores / water valves / debris piles are shut off / put out.
Penalty for failing a sabotage: if the Civilian / non-Killer Neutral neutral roles do not resolve the sabotage within the time limit, everyone loses half of their Sanity bar's worth of Sanity, and all items on them enter a 15-second cooldown.
map_intro.mechanic.conduit_core.title: Conduit Core
map_intro.mechanic.conduit_core.body: Underwater maps usually have a conduit mechanism; conduit energy grants all players underwater night vision and water breathing. The Killer can go to the conduit and actively shut it off through the mechanism.
map_intro.mechanic.game_currency.title: Game Currency
map_intro.mechanic.game_currency.body:
There are 2 types of currency in the game.
Coin: the most common currency, used to buy items from role shops / vending machines. Coins are usually earned by completing tasks / passive income.
Game tokens: you earn 2 game tokens when completing a minigame task. Game tokens can buy items from vending machines / lottery machines (minigame tasks are only enabled on specific maps).
map_intro.mechanic.train_target.title: Train Target / Target
map_intro.mechanic.train_target.body: Train target: triggers a redstone mechanism when hit by a pistol / sniper rifle. Target: triggers a redstone mechanism when hit by a projectile.
map_intro.mechanic.special_roles.title: Roles That Spawn on Specific Maps
map_intro.mechanic.special_roles.body:
The following roles only appear on specific maps
Bag Ghost map: Ma chen xu, Wraith Guest
Large map: SWAT
Underwater map: Sea King, Water Ghost, Diver
Sky map: Shadow Falcon, Pilot
Mechanism map: Adventurer
Horseback map: Tamer, Hunter
Meeting map: Canadian Goose
Meeting-vote map: Dummy Bird, Politician, Missionary
